objectives.description: Add lintDriver := "batteries/runLinter" to package Logos where in lakefile.lean
Determine lake lint's default module scope
objectives.note: lake lint (no args) == lake lint --builtin-lint FormalSystem exactly (same 307 errors / 11005 declarations). BimodalTest is NOT pulled into the default scope; lake lint --builtin-lint BimodalTest adds BimodalTest text-linter findings on top of (additive to) the FormalSystem default, confirming BimodalTest requires an explicit module arg and is additive, not exclusive. lake lint <MODULE> (bare, without --builtin-lint) errors 'unexpected arguments' -- MODULE positional only works alongside a builtin-lint-triggering flag.

objectives.note: Whole if: block (with its 3-line comment) deleted; on: already lists push/pull_request on main.

objectives.description: Set test: true and lint: true
Add lint-args narrowing to blocking subset; verify flag spelling
objectives.note: Extended investigation (see approaches_tried): first attempt (--lint-only .dupNamespace bare) was OOM-killed at 2585/2590 mid-rebuild, then retried and found to NOT actually narrow the driver's own report at all (307-error batch still present alongside dupNamespace's 14 warnings) -- --lint-only only affects Lean-core-registered linter.X options (a separate mechanism from Batteries' @[env_linter] family), and only takes effect when --builtin-only also skips the driver. --builtin-only --lint-only .dupNamespace correctly isolates dupNamespace: 14 real findings (ChronicleTypes.lean Chronicle namespace/structure collision), confirmed 'No environment linters were run for FormalSystem.' simpNF was found to be UNREACHABLE via this path at all: grep across the pinned Batteries+Mathlib source confirms no bare `linter.simpNF` option is registered (only `linter.simpNF.respectTransparency`, a sub-tunable) -- simpNF exists exclusively as a Batteries @[env_linter], reachable only via the driver, and runLinter.lean's own CLI parser (read directly) has no linter-selection flag at all, always calling getChecks(runOnly := none). So: no lint-args string narrows the driver below its full 307-error batch, and no lint-args string can isolate simpNF in isolation. Verified against the exact CI-equivalent invocation (plain `lake lint`, no flags): exit 1, 307 errors, zero dupNamespace mentions -- confirms unnarrowed lint: true cannot land. CURRENTLY UNDER INVESTIGATION: scripts/nolints.json grandfathering (runLinter.lean:133-135/152-170/188-189, confirmed present and read unconditionally on the normal path) as an alternative that could let lint: true land with the 307 existing findings grandfathered and only new violations failing the build -- see objective 9.

Run exact narrowed command locally, confirm exit 0

objectives.description: Investigate scripts/nolints.json grandfathering as an alternative to lint: false
objectives.note: Team-lead-directed investigation, confirmed successful. runLinter.lean reads scripts/nolints.json unconditionally on every run (not gated behind --update), filtering grandfathered (linter, decl) pairs out of each linter's failing-declarations set before computing pass/fail. .lake/packages/batteries/scripts/nolints.json and .lake/packages/mathlib/scripts/nolints.json both exist on disk, confirming this is the standard upstream mechanism, not a workaround. Sequence run: (1) `lake exe runLinter --update FormalSystem` -- exit 1 (expected: this run's own pass/fail still judges against the PRE-update nolints set read at the start of the run; the file write is a side effect that lands regardless), created scripts/nolints.json (26720 bytes, 307 entries: unusedArguments=217, docBlame=51, defsWithUnderscore=33, tacticDocs=4, simpNF=1, structureInType=1). One hiccup along the way: the first attempt hit a missing .olean for FormalSystem.ForMathlib (stale cache from the earlier linter-option flip-flopping); a plain `lake build` (exit 0, confirmed clean) fixed it before retrying. (2) Plain `lake lint` -- exit 0, confirmed. (3) Reverted ci.yml's lint:false back to lint:true (no lint-args), with an updated comment explaining the grandfathering design. YAML re-validated, lake check-lint re-confirmed exit 0. (4) Re-ran lake test with captured output (the background run's result had been feared lost, though its completion notification did arrive to this session with exit 0 -- re-ran anyway per instruction to always capture explicitly): exit 0. dupNamespace's 14 warnings confirmed unaffected by nolints.json -- still absent from every plain `lake lint` invocation (different mechanism, never reaches the driver).

approaches_tried.reason: Does not narrow the driver's own report at all (307 errors still present); only isolates dupNamespace's text-linter warnings additively. Silent no-op for the intended narrowing purpose -- would look configured in ci.yml and do nothing.

approaches_tried.reason: simpNF is structurally unreachable via this path (no registered linter.simpNF option); dupNamespace is reachable but has 14 real findings, not zero. No lint-args string narrows the driver's own env_linter batch at all (runLinter.lean's CLI has no linter-selection flag, always calls getChecks(runOnly := none)).

approaches_tried.approach: scripts/nolints.json grandfathering via lake exe runLinter --update
approaches_tried.reason: Standard Batteries/Mathlib mechanism, confirmed present and read unconditionally in this pinned runLinter.lean. Grandfathers the 307 pre-existing findings; plain lake lint (CI's literal invocation) exits 0 and now fails only on a genuinely new finding. Adopted as the final design -- lint: true lands with no lint-args.

deviations.description: lint-args narrows to the blocking subset confirmed green in Phase 1 (simpNF, dupNamespace)
deviations.reason: Investigation found simpNF is structurally unreachable via any narrowing flag, and dupNamespace has 14 real findings, so no lint-args narrowing is possible. Superseded by a materially better mechanism: scripts/nolints.json grandfathers the full 307-finding env_linter batch (Batteries/Mathlib's own standard approach), so lint: true lands with the complete linter set live as a regression gate, rather than a permanently narrowed two-linter subset. This is not a Contingency #3 outcome (lint: false) -- the plan's actual Goal (`lint: true` in ci.yml) is achieved, by a different, better mechanism than the plan's own lint-args narrowing sketch.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — lint-args narrowing is structurally impossible; superseded by scripts/nolints.json grandfathering, which achieves the plan's actual lint:true goal via a better mechanism)*
